verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekagandhampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, purisagandho.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single smell that occupies a woman’s mind like the smell of a man.

verses.pali: Purisagandho, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The smell of a man occupies a woman’s mind.”
